question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 
 

 3
 16
 26
 
 

 4
 20
 32
 
 

 6
 28
 ?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Column 1 : 3, 4, 6

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c01ae4d7d75a3809c1235e19a75035398b50abd6dfa9572a911cc1cd81e6a984.png] 

Column 2 : 16, 20, 28

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4f0aaa0f4021d58fcf6d761460b8238b59be079a1eb84029fdae527cfdcbb88.png] 

Column 3 : 26, 32, ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/115682e483bbfe7ad7138e8fbc9c13c85a087e23d7ead1be86dbc4e10ce15d9e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"44".**
